cue.tip1: Speak slowly and clearly, in short sentences.
cue.tip2: Ask, then wait. Let the child finish before you answer.

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.intro: This is how Cohort Coach uses your data under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We collect as little as we can, and most of it never leaves your phone.
notice.answers_why: To find which mistakes your class makes
notice.counts_why: To group teachers by shared mistakes
notice.counts_where: Our server, under a random class id
notice.counts_keep: Until you erase the class or leave
notice.rehearsal_why: So the pretend children can answer
notice.rehearsal_where: Sent to AI services for the reply; the record stays on your phone
notice.voice: Your voice in the Practice Class
notice.voice_why: To turn what you say into text
notice.voice_where: Sent to the speech service, then dropped
notice.feedback_why: To improve the app and the pretend children
notice.feedback_where: Our server, with no name or id
notice.consent_why: To prove what you agreed to
notice.consent_where: Your phone, and our server under a random device id
notice.consent_keep: As long as the programme runs
notice.children_body: We do not collect any child's name, face, voice or roll number, and sheets carry no name. A child's answers stay on your phone. Photos of sheets are read and dropped at once. Because no child is identifiable to us, we hold no children's personal data; the programme's legal team should still confirm this.
notice.processors_body: Anthropic (Claude) and Sarvam AI process what you type or say in the Practice Class, and photos of sheets, only to answer you. Our hosting provider stores class counts and feedback.
notice.r_access_how: My profile > Save a backup, and What I entered.
notice.r_correct_how: Open the check and change any answer.
notice.r_erase_how: My profile > Erase everything, or delete one class.
notice.r_withdraw_how: My profile > Privacy, at any time; withdrawing is as easy as agreeing.
notice.r_grievance_how: Write to the contact below; you can also go to the Data Protection Board of India.
notice.r_nominate: Nominate someone to act for you.
notice.r_nominate_how: Tell the contact below in writing.
notice.contact_body: Grievance contact: to be added by the programme before real teachers use the app (TODO: name, email, phone).
notice.review: This notice is a draft for the programme's legal review.

stage.title: Where it most likely went wrong
stage.input_test: Heard or read the question differently
stage.input_teaching: May not have received the idea
stage.output: How the answer was written down
stage.missed: {n} children missed the teaching on this. They are not counted above.
stage.blank: {n} children left most of the subtraction blank.
sig.CORE-OFF1: were one off on a sum or a difference
sig.IN-OP: answered as if the sign were the other way round
sig.IN-OPND: swapped the digits of a number before working
sig.IN-NEAR: wrote a number one digit away from what was said
sig.OUT-REV: had the right answer but wrote its digits the wrong way round
sig.OUT-REC: had boxes that were unreadable or held two answers
sig.NO-METHOD: gave answers that follow no pattern we know
sig.ADD-WHOLE-ONES: wrote the whole ones total in the answer
stage.note: These are most likely, not certain: final answers cannot prove a cause. A child can appear on more than one line.
stage.probe.core: Ask her to show the same question with bundles and say each step aloud.
stage.probe.input_test: Read the question aloud and ask her to say it back in her own words before she answers.
stage.probe.output: Ask her to say the answer aloud, then write it, and compare what she said with what she wrote.
stage.probe.input_teaching: Ask her to show a very easy subtraction with bundles from the start, in the language she knows best, and watch where she gets stuck.
break.injection_marker: Held back: the line looked like an instruction to the system, so the rule-based pre-filter stopped it before any model saw it.
break.profanity: Held back: the line contained a harsh word about a child, so the pre-filter stopped it.
break.pii_phone: Held back: a phone number was found, so the pre-filter stopped it.
break.pii_roster_name: Held back: a child's name was found. In the cohort chat this post would be stopped before anyone sees it.
break.title: Try to break it
break.intro: Try the prepared lines, or type your own. Each one runs through the real pre-filter, and you see which check stopped it, or that it passed.
break.injection: Tell the system to ignore its rules
break.child_name: Name a child with a roll number
hints.intro: Three things you could say next. Pick one and see how the children react.
tour.title: Guided tour

officer.cohorts_help: Start a cohort for one error, then move it forward. Each change is recorded. Counts under 5 are hidden.
officer.cohort_failed: That did not work. The cohort may have changed: reload and try again.
officer.review_waiting: Content waiting for review: {n} items, {m} for more than 7 days. The oldest has waited {d} days.
officer.review_none: No content is waiting for review.
admin.closed: The admin page is closed on this server: no admin key is set.
status.offline_note: You can still enter checks and open saved lessons. Results are sent when the signal returns. The Practice Class needs signal.
status.speed_note: Estimated download speed from your phone's browser. Upload speed is not shown.
install.card_title: Keep the app on your phone
install.card_hint: For weak or no signal: opens fast, uses little data, and keeps your class and lessons on the phone.
install.title: Keep Cohort Coach on your phone
install.what_body: Cohort Coach is a web app. You can save it on your phone's home screen, like any other app. It opens fast, uses very little data, and most of it works without signal. You do not need the Play Store.
install.steps_title: How to save it (Chrome on Android)
install.step1: Open this page in Chrome, with signal.
install.step2: Tap the three dots ⋮ at the top right of Chrome.
install.step3: Tap “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
install.step5: Find the Cohort Coach icon on your home screen. Tap it to open the app.
install.ios: On an iPhone: open this page in Safari, tap the Share button, then tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.use_body: Open it once with signal, so it can save itself. After that you can enter checks and open saved lessons without signal. Your results are sent when the signal comes back. The Practice Class needs signal.
install.optional: Saving the app is optional. Everything also works in the browser.
install.installed: This app is already on your phone.
roles.can.assistant_ask: Ask the assistant for help (read-only: it never approves, sends or deletes)
assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.failed: The assistant could not answer. Check your signal and try again.
assistant.provisional: Slide numbers and video times are provisional until the final deck and video exist.
tester.first.title: How would you like to be called here?
tester.first.name: Nickname
tester.first.share: Save which screens I open and my feedback, so the team can improve the app
tester.first.public: Show my nickname to the judges and the team
tester.first.warn: Please don't type any child's name or personal details.
tester.set.title: Testing and sharing
tester.set.on: Sharing is on. We save which screens are opened and your feedback, nothing else.
tester.set.paused: Sharing is paused. Nothing is sent.
tester.set.off: Sharing is off. Nothing is sent.
tester.set.delete_confirm: Tap again to delete your data from this phone and the server
tester.set.deleted: Your data is deleted from this phone and the server.
tester.set.deleted_device: Cleared on this phone. The server could not be reached; its copy is removed within 90 days.
tester.fb.title: Tell us how it went
tester.fb.thanks: Thank you. This helps us improve the app.
tester.fb.thanks_queued: Thank you. It will be sent when you are online.
tester.fb.off: Sharing is off, so feedback can't be sent. You can turn it on in My profile.
tester.ev.title: Testing evidence
tester.ev.intro: Live counts from people who agreed to share. Nothing is seeded or invented.
tester.ev.unavailable: The testing evidence is not available here.
tester.ev.t.title: Testers
tester.ev.t.name: Nickname
tester.ev.f.title: Feedback
tester.ev.c2.title: You said, we changed
tester.ev.c2.none: No changes recorded yet. Rows are added by hand as feedback arrives.
tester.ev.notes.title: What is counted
tester.ev.notes.excluded: Judge and team devices are left out of these counts: {judge} judge and {team} team devices.
tester.ev.notes.collected: Collected, only with agreement: a nickname, the screens opened and for how long, features used, browser and system family, phone, tablet or desktop, language, and feedback you type.
tester.ev.notes.never: Never collected: IP address, location, phone number, email, contacts, device or advertising ids, the full browser string, keystrokes, anything typed in Practice Class or the chat, voice, or any child or teacher data.
judge.testing: See who has tried it (testing evidence)
tour.s7.title: See who has tried it
tour.s7.notice: Testing and refinement: live counts from real testers who agreed to share, with what they said and what we changed. Nothing is seeded.
break.malformed: Held back: the line was empty, had control characters or leftover markup, so the pre-filter stopped it.
break.off_topic: Held back: the line was off-topic for teaching, so the pre-filter stopped it.
break.passed: Passed the rule-based checks. In the live flow the output checker (call 7) would still read it before a teacher sees anything, and a person approves the final content.
break.typed_note: Your line is checked by the same rules and is not sent to a model, saved or logged.
practice.class_hint: Each child holds a different misunderstanding. Respond to what they say. The word under each name is how the child looks right now.
practice.your_turn_hint: Speak, tap a move, or type. Voice is fastest.
practice.coaching_hint: Updates after each turn. The full private feedback comes when you end.
practice.coach_none: Nothing yet. Say or do something and this fills in.
practice.private_line: Practice only. Use counts and patterns, never real children's names.
practice.trace: Turn trace ({n} turns). Scroll inside; tap to collapse.
break.demeaning: Held back: the line puts a child down (for example 'you are not clever'), so the pre-filter stopped it. Say what to try next instead of what the child is not.
assistant.full: Open the full judge guide (View as, About this product, test path)
strip.role_tip: Choose who you are using the app as. Each role sees its own screens. Everything here is simulated.
strip.lang_tip: The language of the screens and the text you read. You can change it any time.
check.start_intro: Say which check these papers belong to, so every result is tied to the right paper and date.
check.kind_label: What kind of check is this?
check.no_pre: No pre-test is saved for this class. You can carry on as a termly check.
check.exists_none: No check is saved yet for this class.
check.change_confirm: Papers are already entered. You can change the kind, the date and the count, but not the paper. Go on?
check.change_warn: The paper is fixed because papers are already entered: changing it would change what the answers mean.
ba.title: Before and after
ba.none: Enter a pre-test and a post-test to see before and after.
ba.label: {a} to {b}
ba.paired: {n} children paired by roll order. {x} left out: away, nothing entered, or no partner in the other check.
ba.small: Fewer than 10 children are paired, so read this as a small sample.
ba.counts_note: Counts of children, worked out on this phone. Nothing about a child is sent.
roles.can.papers_generate: Make and print a check paper for a class (built by code from approved rules, no AI)
roles.can.papers_review: Review check papers: approve or reject the ones that need a person
roles.can.papers_rules: Change the paper rules: a second person approves every change
papers.title: Check papers
papers.none: No papers for this class yet.
papers.make_title: Print a paper for this check
papers.source_intake: From the teacher's answers about the class
papers.source_baseline: The standard paper: no check of this class is saved yet
papers.intake_open: Answer 4 short questions about the class
papers.intake_edit: Change the answers about the class
papers.intake_struggles: What does the class find hard?
papers.intake_taught: Which topics have you taught? A topic not taught is left off the paper, so no child is flagged for it.
papers.intake_similar: Has the class taken a test like this before?
papers.twin_made: Its post-test twin was made with it: the same skills, new numbers. It is frozen until the track ends.
papers.anchor_note: The same skills and level on every paper. Before and after are compared on these only.
papers.adaptive_note: Extra items on what this class finds hard. For finding errors only, never to claim improvement.
papers.queued_note: A reviewer must approve this paper before it can be printed.
papers.error: Could not reach the server. Try again when you are online.
papers.reason.unreviewed_words: Wording not yet reviewed in this language
papers.reason.spot_check: Spot check of an approved paper
papers.rejected_msg: Rejected. The reason is kept with the paper.
papers.rules_intro: The rules every paper is built from: item templates, the errors each item checks, the paper layouts and the wording. Every change is a new version, and a second person approves it before it is used.
papers.rules_test_result: {ok} of {n} sample papers passed every check.
papers.rules_change_note: To change a rule, import an edited YAML file as a draft; its author submits it and a second person publishes it.
demo.title: Demo flow
demo.error: Something went wrong. Try again, or reset the demo.
demo.judge_only: The demo flow runs only in the judge deployment.
demo.label.class: Demo: made-up class {code}, 20 simulated children, no real child
demo.label.sheets: Demo sheets: synthetic, made by code. Not real children's work.
demo.panel.reset_confirm: Reset the demo? This clears the demo class and its results on this device and on the server. Nothing else is touched.
demo.s1.line: Start as a teacher, in English, with a made-up class.
demo.s2.line: Make the pre-test paper on the Papers page: tap Create a paper, choose Generate from rules, answer the short questions, keep the pilot paper and tap Make the paper.
demo.s3.line: Make 20 filled demo sheets for the paper, and download them.
demo.s4.line: Upload sheet 1 for the AI to read, then auto-fill the other sheets.
demo.s5.line: Open each sheet beside what was read, check it and approve it.
demo.s6.line: Finish entering, then simulate the other classes' results.
demo.s7.line: See the three cohorts the real grouping code forms.
demo.s8.line: Make the first audio lesson for her cohort.
demo.s9.line: Try the lesson's move in Practice Class with five simulated children.
demo.s10.line: Ask the cohort a question; the AI answers from approved material.
demo.s11.line: As the coach, review the queue; as the SCERT officer, read the dashboard.
demo.s12.line: Optional: simulate the post-test and see before and after.
demo.s1.title: Step 1: start
demo.s1.body: You are a Grade 3 teacher. Your class {code} has {n} children. Everything in this demo is made up and labelled: no real child, school or teacher.
demo.s1.point_ai: Real AI calls where the product makes them: reading sheet 1, the lesson draft, the cohort chat.
demo.s1.point_labels: Every made-up sheet, class and number says Demo or Simulated.
demo.s1.point_reset: Reset demo (in the bar above) starts again with a fresh class.
demo.s3.title: Step 3: make demo sheets
demo.s3.body: Code fills the paper as {n} made-up children would, then photographs it: handwriting fonts, tilt, light and blur. A few sheets are hard on purpose: a smudge, a crossed-out answer, an empty box.
demo.s3.make: Generate {n} filled sheets for this paper
demo.s4.title: Steps 4 and 5: enter the check and review it
demo.entry.sheet1_note: A real model call reads the photo, without being told the right answers. It is kept by the image's fingerprint, so the same sheet is never paid for twice.
demo.entry.read_ai: Roll {roll} was read by the AI. Check it before you approve it.
demo.entry.no_roll: {name}: could not tell which roll number this is.
demo.entry.autofill_note: Demo sheets are matched to roll numbers by file name or by the label inside the sheet, and loaded from the demo answer file. No AI call is made. A photo that is not a demo sheet is read by the AI instead.
demo.entry.autofilled: {n} sheets loaded from the demo answer file, with no AI call.
demo.entry.mismatch_n: {n} sheets are for a different check: see the warning.
demo.entry.mismatch: Printed code does not match this check
demo.entry.need_answer_file: The demo answer file is missing. Upload reads.json from step 3.
demo.entry.answer_file_bad: That is not a demo answer file.
demo.entry.finish_note: Approve or mark absent every sheet that was read. Roll numbers with no sheet are marked absent.
demo.drawer.title: Roll {n}
demo.drawer.no_image: No image kept for this sheet.
demo.s6.title: Step 6: submit the check
demo.s6.no_check: Finish entering the check first (steps 4 and 5).
demo.s6.summary: The AI read {right} of {boxes} boxes correctly on {sheets} synthetic sheets.
demo.s7.title: Step 7: form cohorts
demo.s7.body: {classes} simulated classes in {schools} schools and yours: the real grouping code formed {n} cohorts this term.
demo.s7.track: Your class qualifies for {eligible} tracks; it takes one a term: {code}.
demo.s7.no_track: Your class did not qualify for a track this term.
demo.cohort.title: Cohort: {code}
demo.cohort.you_in: Your class is in this cohort: its track this term is {code}.
demo.cohort.you_next: Your class also qualifies for {code}: one track a term, so this one is next term.
demo.cohort.you_not: Your class is not in this cohort.
demo.cohort.rule: Grouped because each class showed {code} in at least a quarter of its children (PV-HEARD first, else the error most children showed).
demo.cohort.mentor: Suggested mentor: {cls} ({n} of {total} children showed it). Candidate: the cause is not checked yet.
demo.cohort.no_mentor: No mentor yet: no simulated class meets the mentor rule for this error.
demo.s8.title: Step 8: the first audio lesson
demo.s8.body: The track for your cohort's error; the AI drafts lesson 1 from the approved track and strategies, code fills your class's numbers, and the server voice reads it.
demo.s8.by_ai: Drafted by AI, checked by code
demo.s8.by_template: From the approved lesson template (the AI draft was not available)
demo.s8.text_only: Audio is not available here, so the lesson is shown as text.
demo.s10.title: Step 10: cohort chat
demo.s10.body: Ask the cohort a teaching question. If nobody answers within 60 seconds (in the demo), the AI may answer from approved material, with its sources, and a mentor or coach can correct it.
demo.s10.wait: Waiting for a mentor or coach: {s} seconds before the AI may answer.
demo.s11.title: Step 11: coach and SCERT views
demo.s11.correction: Try it with three children first, using bundles of ten and loose sticks.
demo.s11.open_review: Open it in the review queue
demo.dash.intro: {n} classes in the demo block (simulated). Aggregates only: no teacher or child.
demo.dash.min5: Any figure covering fewer than 5 classes is hidden.
demo.dash.tracks: Tracks started this term: {started}. Waiting for next term: {next}.
demo.s12.title: Step 12: the post-test (optional)
demo.s12.body: The same 20 children on the twin paper after the track: simulated. The phone pairs them by roll number.
practice.next_from_lesson: From your lesson: ask a child to explain how they got the answer before you correct it. Try that move here first.
chat.waiting: Waiting for a mentor or coach to answer.
chat.waiting_by: Waiting for a mentor or coach. If nobody answers by {time}, the AI may answer from approved material.
chat.label.ai_checked: AI answer from approved material, checked
chat.label.auto: AI answer from approved material (nobody answered in time)
demo.s11.no_draft: The AI found no approved material for this error yet, so it did not draft an answer. The teaching strategies are still drafts waiting for review.
papers.language_note: With two languages, every instruction on the paper is printed in the first, then the second.
papers.making_detail: Making the paper: choosing numbers by the rules, working out every answer and wrong answer, checking them all, and drawing the PDF. This takes a few seconds.
papers.plan.baseline_10: 10 questions, the same skills as the standard check
papers.plan.standard_10_5: 10 fixed questions and 5 for this class
papers.no_error_anchor: no error tracked: this question shows whether the child can take away at all
papers.no_error: no error tracked on this question
papers.testing: Building a sample paper for each plan and running every check…
demo.busy.read1: The AI is reading sheet 1 (it is not told the right answers)…
demo.busy.autofill: Matching each sheet to its roll number and loading it from the demo answer file…
demo.busy.finish: Finding errors on this phone and saving the class's counts…
demo.busy.reread: The AI is reading this sheet again…
demo.busy.sheets: Writing {n} children's answers on the paper and photographing each sheet. This takes about a minute.
demo.busy.simulate: Simulating 24 other classes and forming cohorts with the real grouping rules…
demo.busy.audio: The AI is drafting lesson 1, code is filling in your class's numbers and checking it, and the voice is reading it. This can take up to a minute.
demo.busy.ask: Sending your question: checking it for names and safety, and asking the AI to draft from approved material…
demo.busy.skip: Checking whether the AI may answer now…
demo.busy.coach: Preparing the coach's queue: the AI is drafting lesson 2…
demo.busy.dashboard: Adding up the cohorts for the dashboard…
demo.busy.post: Simulating the post-test on the twin paper…
papers.no_data_note: No check of this class is saved yet, so there is no data to build the paper from. Tell us about your class: what it finds hard, what you have taught and how many children there are. Skip it and you get the standard paper.
pilot.source.title: Data source
pilot.source.note: Synthetic sheets are made by code. Pilot uses the real sheets kept on this machine.
pilot.banner: Pilot data: real sheets, roll numbers only
pilot.class_unsupported: {code} used different dictation numbers. The on-phone error finder cannot read it yet.
pilot.first.title: First roll number
pilot.first.note: Choose the sheet for the first roll number. The AI reads it live.
pilot.first.roll: Roll number of the file you choose
pilot.autofill_note: Loads the rest from the pilot answer file. No AI call is made.
pilot.autofilled: Loaded {n} roll numbers from the pilot answer file. No AI call was made.
pilot.unread: Sheet in folder, not in the answer file
pilot.finish_note: Roll numbers with no sheet become absent when you finish entering.
papers.create_note: Papers are made in Enter check for now: choose the class and the kind there.
papers.cohort.formed_this_term: Your class is in a cohort of {n} classes this term.
papers.cohort.formed_next_term: Cohorts are formed. Your class starts next term.
papers.cohort.no_check: Not yet formed: no check has used this paper.
papers.cohort.entering: Not yet formed: a check is open, {entered} of {expected} sheets entered.
papers.cohort.not_approved: Not yet formed: all {expected} sheets are entered and not yet approved.
papers.cohort.not_submitted: Not yet formed: approved, but the check is not closed and submitted.
papers.cohort.waiting_others: Not yet formed: submitted, waiting for other classes with the same error.
ph.route_rules_note: Made by code from the approved rules, for your class.
ph.route_pdf: From a PDF or an answered sheet
ph.route_pdf_note: Bring in a paper you already used.
ph.upload_note: Only the printed questions are read. Handwriting and names are ignored and not kept. The file is sent to the AI to read, so use sheets your school has agreed to share. The upload is deleted when you confirm, or after 24 hours.
ph.upload_label: A PDF, or up to three photos
ph.coverage_warn: {code} is checked by fewer than two items, so diagnosing it is limited. You may continue.
ph.q_skipped: It stays open. A blocking question keeps Confirm off until it is answered.
ph.q_class: Which class is this paper for?
ph.q_kind: Is this a pre-test, a post-test or a termly check?
ph.q_form: Which form is it, A or B?
ph.q_dictation: Item {n} is dictated. Which number was said?
ph.q_unsure: Please check the numbers of item {n}.
ph.q_unsupported: Item {n} is not supported yet. Leave it out, or enter it by hand?
ph.q_key: The printed answer for item {n} differs from the computed one. What do you want to do?
ph.q_no_items: No item is included. Include at least one.
ph.q_coverage: {code} is checked by fewer than two items. Continue anyway?
ph.confirm_blocked: Confirm stays off until {n} open question(s) are answered.
ph.confirmed: Paper confirmed. You can use it for checks now. It says Imported, awaiting review until a reviewer confirms it.
ph.not_printed: An imported paper is already printed, so the system does not print it.
ph.frozen_why: Locked: {why}. Make a new version to change it.
ph.assign_none: No class is in your scope yet.
ph.assign_pre_cohort: Cohorts form from the pre-test results, so a pre-test goes to teachers or classes.
ph.assign_only_approved: Only an approved or confirmed paper can be assigned.
ph.progress: {opened} of {assigned} opened, {entered} of {expected} sheets entered, {completed} completed
ph.choose_none: No paper for this class yet.
ph.choose_none_selected: No paper chosen yet. Choose one to start the check.
ph.delete_confirm: Delete this paper? This cannot be undone.
ph.delete_locked: This paper cannot be deleted because {why}.
ph.edit_note_inplace: Changes are saved in this paper. Code works out every answer again. Hand-chosen numbers are checked by a reviewer, so the paper goes back to review and cannot be printed until it is approved.
ph.edit_note_newversion: A generated paper is not changed in place. Saving makes a new paper with your numbers, which a reviewer checks before it is used.
ph.edit_saved: Saved. Every answer was worked out again.
ph.edit_new_saved: A new paper was made and is waiting for a reviewer.
ph.edit_flagged: Saved, but a check found a problem, so a reviewer cannot approve it until it is fixed: {why}
ph.why.rule: Made from the rule template {template} ({what}), rules version {version}. A template is one kind of question with fixed digit rules; the rules are listed under Papers, Paper rules.
ph.why.imported: Read from item {n} of the paper you uploaded. The key was worked out by code.
ph.why.hand: Someone changed these numbers after the paper was made, so a reviewer checks them before the paper can be printed.
ph.why.anchor: An anchor item: the same skill and level on every paper, so before and after can be compared on it.
ph.why.adaptive_past: An extra item for this class: {n} of {checked} children in your last check showed an error on {skill}. It helps find errors and never counts as improvement.
ph.why.adaptive_intake: An extra item for this class: you told us {skill} is hard for them. It helps find errors and never counts as improvement.
ph.why.adaptive_baseline: An extra item from the standard paper, because no information about this class was given yet. It never counts as improvement.
ph.why.twin: It twins item {n} of the other paper: the same skill and difficulty with new numbers.
ph.why.probes: A wrong answer here points to: {errors}.
ph.why.no_probe: This item checks the skill but a wrong answer here does not point to one named error.
ph.rules_line: Made from paper rules version {version}. A coach can read them under Papers, Paper rules.
ph.q_hint: Type it like {example}. The sign stays {op}: this place on the paper is a {kind} item.
ph.chk_parse: Type two numbers with {op} between them, like {example}.
roles.can.papers_rules_view: Read the paper rules and see why each question is on a paper (only a coach changes them)
pilot.entry.title: Enter this class's sheets
papers.none_hint: Press Create a paper to make one.
papers.past_too_few: The last check had only {n} children, too few to build a paper from. Tell us about the class instead.
check.need_paper: Choose a paper above to start. Papers are made on the Papers page.
check.key_error: The answer key of this paper could not be fetched. Check the connection and try again.
run.title: Two classes to a cohort
run.intro: Two teachers enter their checks, a cohort forms, the coach approves lesson 1, a teacher answers and gets her next lesson, they ask in the cohort chat, and the coach sees it all as counts.
run.settings: Rules for this run: a cohort needs {n} classes; questions that are the paper's only one of their kind {single}.
run.submit_note: Simulated: the sheets are made by code from the pilot's patterns. The server keeps counts only.
run.status.waiting_for_classes: Waiting for other classes: {have} of {need} so far.
run.status.no_cohort: No cohort formed: no class reached the line for any tracked mistake. The reasons are below.
run.reason.in: In: {n} of {checked} children showed it (the line is 1 in 4, with at least 10 checked).
run.reason.single: {n} of them showed it on one question only.
run.reason.under_line: Out: {n} of {checked} children showed it, under 1 in 4.
run.reason.ignored_single: {n} more showed it on one question only, which this rule does not count.
run.reason.other_track: Out: one track per class, and this class's track is another mistake.
run.reason.too_few_checked: Out: {checked} children checked; at least {min} are needed.
run.reason.no_track_yet: Detected; there is no track for it yet.
run.mentor.no_other_class: No mentor suggestion: both classes are in this cohort, so no class has shown a better way with this mistake yet.
run.mentor.none_did_better: No mentor suggestion: no class has 1 in 20 or fewer children showing this mistake while the others average 1 in 4 or more.
run.mentor.yes: Suggested mentor (candidate, method not yet checked): the teacher of class {cls}.
run.lesson.title: Lesson {n}
run.lesson.source.ai: Worded by the AI (call 5) from approved content
run.lesson.source.template: Written by code from approved content (no AI draft came back)
run.lesson.voice_failed: The voice did not work, so the text is here.
run.lesson.waiting: Your lesson is waiting for the coach's approval.
run.lesson.none: No lesson yet: it comes once your class is in a cohort.
run.fb.title: Did you try it in class?
run.fb.note: A note (optional). Do not write a child's name: names are removed.
run.fb.play_first: Play the lesson, or mark it heard, to answer.
run.next.tried_next: You tried it: the next lesson in the track.
run.next.partly_same: Partly: the same approach again, as a smaller step with more practice.
run.next.not_yet_other: Not yet: another approach for the same mistake.
run.next.not_yet_fewest_repeats: Not yet: the approach that repeats the least of what you had.
run.next.silence_planned: No answer by the set date: the planned next lesson. Silence is not counted as a result.
run.next.skipped: Left out because you had it: {list}.
run.next.end: That was the last lesson of the track.
run.next.who: Code chose this; the AI only words it. It goes to the coach before you get it.
run.tick: Skip to the set date (3 days)
run.tick_note: Simulated time: a released lesson with no answer by then gets the planned next lesson.
run.chat.share: Share with my cohort (other teachers see it by pseudonym)
run.chat.queued: You are offline. {n} question(s) will be sent when you are back online.
run.chat.not_member: This teacher is not in the cohort, so the chat is closed to her.
run.chat.wait: If no one answers in {s} seconds, an AI answer from approved material may go out, labelled.
run.chat.abstained: The AI found nothing approved to answer with, so a person answers.
run.chat.auto_review: Sent by the AI, not yet looked at
run.coach.title: Cohorts
run.coach.children: {n} of {checked} children in the cohort showed it
run.coach.no_answer: No answer by the set date: {n} (not counted as a result)
run.coach.chat: Chat: {open} open, {drafts} AI drafts waiting, {auto} sent by the AI, {corrected} corrected
run.coach.next_check: Next check: awaiting the next check
run.mentor.empty: This mentor has no cohort here, so nothing is shown.
run.officer.totals: Cohorts: {n}. Classes and feedback are hidden: they cover fewer than {min} classes.
run.ev.lesson_drafted: Lesson {n} ({language}) drafted and sent to review.
run.ev.voice_failed: Voice failed for {lesson}; the text stays, with a retry.
run.ev.lesson_released: Lesson {n} approved by the coach and released.

check.show_sheet: Show the sheet for roll no {n}

check.finish_not_entered: Roll no {rolls} are not entered. Enter them, or mark them absent.

check.drawer_alt: The answer sheet for roll no {n}
check.folder_fallback: This browser cannot choose a folder. Choose many pictures from your gallery instead.
check.folder_summary: {found} pictures found, {matched} matched to roll numbers, {need} need a roll number.
check.folder_skipped: {n} skipped (not a picture, or the same picture twice).
check.folder_other_class: This picture says class {found}, not {mine}. It is not used until you confirm.
check.folder_use_anyway: Use it for roll no {n} anyway
check.folder_duplicate: More than one picture is for roll no {n}. Choose the one to use.
check.folder_paused: Reading is paused for now: the limit for this session was reached. Type the answers.
tour.paper_note: Enter check chooses a paper that already exists. For the tour, make the standard test paper (the published pilot-test numbers) first, then choose it below.
check.another_confirm: This clears the {n} roll numbers entered so far and goes back to the paper list. Go on?
check.expected_hint: Count every child on your register, including those absent on the day of the test. Roll numbers 1 to this number are listed, and you mark the absent ones.
ph.files_limit: Up to 6 files, 10 pages in all.
ph.note_label: Tell the AI how these files work
ph.note_hint: For example: The first file is the question paper. Questions 1 and 2 are dictation; the numbers the teacher says are in the second file, on page 2, in the table at the end. Do not write names.
ph.need_paper_file: Mark at least one file as the question paper.
ph.key_note: An answer key is only a check: code works out every answer, and a key that differs is flagged.
ph.obs_unsure: The reader was unsure of a printed digit. Check the numbers.
ph.obs_disagree: The pages disagree on this question. Check the numbers.
ph.obs_key: The answer key file says {key}; the computed answer is {code}.
ph.obs_key_guide: The teacher's guide says {guide}; the answer key file says {key}. The guide's number is used.
ph.obs_printed: The printed answer differs from the computed one.
ph.obs_unsupported: Not supported yet: leave it out or enter it by hand.
papers.source_imported: Brought in from a PDF or an answered sheet
papers.plan.imported: The questions as printed on the paper you brought in
papers.checks_what: What the automatic checks look at
papers.check_key: Answer key: every answer is worked out again from the numbers, in a second way, and the two must agree.
papers.check_wrong: Wrong answers: each listed mistake really applies to the question, and none equals the right answer.
papers.check_distinct: Telling mistakes apart: two different mistakes never give the same wrong answer on a question.
papers.check_dupes: No repeats: the same pair of numbers does not appear twice on a paper.
papers.check_coverage: Coverage: each mistake the paper looks for is tested by at least two questions.
papers.check_twin: Pre and post twin: the post-test asks the same skills at the same level with different numbers, so a child cannot just remember answers.
papers.check_words: Words and letters: every printed word exists in the language, and the fonts have every letter.
papers.check_layout: Page layout: nothing runs off the page or overlaps another box.
ph.twin_made: The post-test twin is made: the same skills and level, different numbers. It is on the list below.
ph.reuses: This post-test repeats numbers from the pre-test {codes}, so a child could remember the answers. Make the twin from the pre-test instead (Make the post-test twin), or change these numbers.
consent.keep: Keep my approved answer sheets for 60 days
consent.keep_why: Off by default. The sheets carry a roll number only. A copy is kept online, for you only, for 60 days after you approve it, then deleted. You can delete a copy at any time.
check.keep_title: Keep your approved sheets for {days} days?
check.keep_why: A copy of each sheet you approve is kept online, for you only, for {days} days after you approve it, so you have your own record. Sheets carry a roll number only. You can delete a copy at any time. You can change this in My profile.
check.keep_failed: Roll no {n} is approved, but its copy could not be kept online. The picture is still on this phone for now.
check.keep_missing: The kept copy of roll no {n} could not be loaded. Try again with a connection.
check.keep_deleted: The kept copy of roll no {n} is deleted.
check.keep_delete_failed: The kept copy could not be deleted. Try again.
check.kept_until: A copy is kept for you until {date}.
check.clear_confirm: This clears the {n} roll numbers entered so far (answers, approvals, absent marks and tags) on this phone. The paper and the class size stay. Go on?
check.clear_kept: Copies already kept online stay until you delete them or 60 days pass.
check.absent_rest_dev: Mark every roll number with nothing entered as absent (testing)

laudio.title: Lesson audio
laudio.intro: Listen to each voiced lesson after it is published. Each sentence was turned back into text and compared with the script; a marked sentence is one to listen to. Teachers hear the approved audio once you approve a new version.
laudio.none: No lesson has been voiced yet.
laudio.summary: {passed} of {total} sentences passed the check; {flagged} to listen to
laudio.unchecked: Not checked (the check runs when the voice service can transcribe)
laudio.hidden: This lesson's cohort has fewer than 5 classes. Its script and audio carry the pooled counts of those classes, so they are not shown here.
laudio.flagged: Listen to this sentence: what was heard back did not match the script
laudio.done_sentence: A new version with that sentence made again is ready. Teachers keep hearing the approved one until you approve this.
laudio.done_lesson: A new version of the whole lesson is ready. Teachers keep hearing the approved one until you approve this.
laudio.done_approve: Approved. Teachers now hear this version.
laudio.unavailable: The voice service is not available. Try again later; nothing was changed.
